court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, maintenance Case No.26 of 2018 under Section 125 Cr.P.C.
case_name: Smt. Shilpa Sharma And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another

parties.respondent_defendant: State of U.P. and Manish Sharma (opposite party)

facts_of_case: Applicants Smt. Shilpa Sharma and her minor son instituted a case under Section 125 Cr.P.C. against opposite party-Manish Sharma who has declined to pay maintenance to applicant no.1 and has provided maintenance to the applicant no.2 Ans Sharma the minor son of the applicant no.1.

legal_principles.principle: A wife's failure to prove grounds for separate living without independent evidence amounts to practising of cruelty against the husband.
legal_principles.held: She failed to prove the grounds of her separate living from her husband by any independent evidence. Keeping into consideration the judgment of Delhi High Court in Smt. Kamini Gupta Vs. Mukesh Kumar Gupta AIR (1995) Delhi 221 and Bhawna N.Shah Vs. Nitin Chiman Lal Shah (2012) 4 Civil Court cases 355 (Bombay) (DB).
cited_cases: Smt. Kamini Gupta Vs. Mukesh Kumar Gupta AIR (1995) Delhi 221
Bhawna N.Shah Vs. Nitin Chiman Lal Shah (2012) 4 Civil Court cases 355 (Bombay) (DB)

legal_principles.principle: A wife's denial of regular income without proof does not entitle her to maintenance.
legal_principles.held: The learned court below has given the finding that the applicant no.1 Smt. Shilpa Sharma is not having any regular source of income.

outcome.final_order: Awarding maintenance under Section 125 Cr.P.C. against opposite party-Manish Sharma at the rate of Rs.5,000/- per month by the order dated 12.07.2019.
